name: fact-dimension-join
description: bounded fact-to-account inner and left joins

queries.name: joined-accounts
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: joined-countries
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: left-join-events
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e LEFT JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
